$comment: Source of truth for Method Reader's window colours, in the Method family palette (site/assets/tokens.css and docs/BRAND.md). The token names are the window's own, kept from the Screepub theme so the code that paints with them did not have to change; `family` names the site token each one takes its value from, or says why it has none. text:true marks a token that sets text; rust/crates/xtask/tests/brand.rs requires a contrast pair for every one. brand/README.md explains the mapping.

panel.role: a Settings section's box, a card on the paper

brass.role: the one accent: buttons, the drop target, the brads, links

note.role: the Beta badge; the family's caution colour, never an accent

alarm.family: none: the site has no error state

ground.role: the desk seen through a punched hole

present.family: none: a status dot, not text
present.role: the dot on a reader the computer can see

bar.role: the tab strip under the title bar, the code chip

rule.role: hairlines: control, card and sheet borders

rule-strong.role: a border that carries meaning (3:1 or more): the drop well, a text field

brass-soft.role: a selection's ground: the chosen segment, the current scene

brass-highlight.role: brad face stop 0.17, and the accent button's hover
